product.name: Library Management System
product.tagline: Catalogue books, manage member borrowing, track overdue returns, and send SMS reminders

sections.problem_statement: School librarians in India currently rely on manual ledger books or fragmented Excel sheets that lead to high rates of book loss and inefficient inventory tracking. Existing enterprise ERPs are often prohibitively expensive and overly complex for small-to-mid-sized private schools, leaving a gap for a lightweight, intuitive solution. This product simplifies circulation management and automates overdue alerts, significantly reducing administrative overhead and increasing book circulation frequency.
target_users: Mrs. Sunita Rao, School Librarian at a CBSE-affiliated secondary school, struggling with manual register entries and time-consuming overdue follow-ups.
Mr. Rajesh Kumar, School Administrator at a budget-private school, needing low-cost, compliant tools to improve operational efficiency and track assets.
Aarav Sharma, a Grade 10 student, facing difficulty in identifying book availability and receiving frequent, unorganized notifications about return deadlines.
user_stories: As a librarian, I want to scan ISBNs to auto-populate book metadata so that I can catalogue 50+ books per hour without manual data entry.
As a librarian, I want to trigger automated SMS reminders for overdue books so that I can reduce book loss rates by 30% per academic term.
As a student, I want to view my current borrowing history and due dates on a dashboard so that I can avoid late fines.
As a school administrator, I want to generate a monthly circulation report so that I can justify the library budget to the management board.
As a librarian, I want to restrict borrowing for users with outstanding fines so that I can maintain the integrity of the school's assets.
mvp_features: Smart Cataloguing: Auto-fetch book metadata via ISBN integration to eliminate manual entry errors.
Circulation Engine: A simple check-in/check-out interface that updates inventory status in real-time.
Automated SMS Gateway: Integration with local SMS APIs to send pre-scheduled reminders for upcoming due dates.
Member Dashboard: A web-view for students to track their borrowing history and upcoming deadlines.
Report Generator: One-click export of monthly circulation and overdue fines to PDF/Excel format.
Fine Management: A ledger to record and track cash payments for late returns, ensuring financial transparency.
future_features: QR Code Generation: Enable students to scan their ID cards for faster check-outs.
Parent Portal Integration: Allow parents to receive SMS alerts regarding their child's library activity.
Recommendations Engine: Suggest books based on borrowing history and popular genres within the school.
E-book Integration: Track digital asset access alongside physical inventory for a hybrid library experience.
success_metrics: Book Loss Rate: Reduce from current industry average of 15% to <3% within 6 months to prove inventory control effectiveness.
SMS Reminder Response Rate: Achieve a 40% reduction in overdue books within 3 months of implementation.
Cataloguing Efficiency: Increase items processed per hour by 5x compared to manual ledger systems.
Churn Rate: Maintain a <5% annual churn rate among school subscriptions by ensuring high platform stability.
assumptions: Schools have stable internet connectivity to support a cloud-based web application.
Librarians are willing to transition from paper-based records to a digital dashboard.
SMS gateway pricing remains stable enough to keep the operational cost per student under ₹5 per year.
risks: Data Privacy Breaches (DPDP Act compliance) → Mitigation: Implement role-based access control (RBAC) and data encryption at rest.
Low User Adoption by non-tech-savvy staff → Mitigation: Provide a 1-hour video training module and a simplified 'one-click' UI.
SMS delivery failures due to DLT regulation → Mitigation: Partner with a verified Indian SMS aggregator (e.g., Gupshup or Twilio) with DLT-compliant templates.
sections.go_to_market: Target private CBSE/ICSE schools via cold email and LinkedIn outreach to school principals and administrators. Offer a 30-day 'Free Pilot' program to demonstrate efficiency gains in a live environment. Convert early adopters into case studies to build trust for a wider regional rollout.
sections.tech_stack_suggestion: Utilize a no-code platform like Bubble.io or Glide for rapid development with a PostgreSQL backend for structured relational data. Use Firebase for authentication and real-time database updates. Integrate with Fast2SMS or Gupshup for DLT-compliant SMS notifications.
sections.monetisation: Charge a SaaS subscription fee of ₹15,000 per year per school, covering up to 500 students and unlimited book entries. Offer a premium support tier at ₹5,000 extra for priority onboarding and dedicated account management. Scale revenue by offering optional add-ons like parent-facing mobile apps or custom reporting modules.
